Remote Work & Data Handling Policy
Effective Date: 1 March 2026 Version: 3.2 Owner: Information Security Office
1. Purpose
This policy establishes the minimum requirements for employees and contractors who access company
systems and customer data while working outside of a company facility. It applies to all business units

and to any third party granted remote access under a signed data processing agreement.
2. Scope
The policy covers laptops, mobile devices, and personal devices enrolled in the mobile device
management (MDM) program. It does not cover physical office access controls, which are addressed in
the Facilities Security Standard.
3. Data Classification Handling

Restricted data, including personally identifiable information (PII) such as government identifiers,
financial account numbers, and health information, must never be stored on local disk outside of the
approved document management system. Restricted data in transit must be encrypted using TLS 1.2
or higher. Confidential data may be cached locally for a maximum of 24 hours and must be cleared

automatically when the device is idle.
4. Access Control
Multi-factor authentication is required for all remote sessions. Session tokens expire after 12 hours of
inactivity. Shared accounts are prohibited; each access event must be attributable to a single named
individual for audit purposes.
5. Incident Reporting

Any suspected exposure of restricted data, including accidental transmission of an unmasked
government identifier or account number, must be reported to the Information Security Office within 4
hours of discovery. Failure to report within this window is treated as a separate policy violation.
6. Enforcement

Violations of this policy may result in revocation of remote access privileges, disciplinary action, or
termination of the applicable contract, consistent with the employee handbook and vendor agreements.

Ticket TCK-48213 (resolved, priority: normal)
Subject: Unable to download invoice PDF from billing portal
Requester: Priya Raghunathan <priya.raghunathan@example.com>
customer: The invoice PDF for August won't download, it just spins forever on the billing page.
agent: Thanks for flagging this, Priya. Could you confirm which browser and whether you're on the new billing portal (v2)?

customer: Chrome on Windows, and yes it's the v2 portal.
agent: Found it — this was a caching bug on our CDN for the v2 portal. Fixed and deployed. You should be able to download now.

customer: My account got locked after I mistyped my authenticator code a few times. I need access before my 10am call.

Ticket TCK-48231 (pending, priority: low)
Subject: Question about data export retention period

Requester: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@example.com>
customer: How long do you retain exported data files before they're purged from the download bucket?
agent: Exports are retained for 30 days from generation, then automatically purged. Let me know if you'd like a longer retention window for your plan.
